title: Patient Management
description: Patient Management documentation for Practice Admin.
overview: This guide covers patient management workflows for Practice Admin.

subtasks.title: Add New Patient (Demographics → Programs → RPM / CCM wizard)
subtasks.purpose: Enrol a new patient into the practice with demographics, care team, program selection, monitoring setup and insurance.

steps.title: Open Add New Patient
steps.description: Click Patient Mgmt in the sidebar and choose Add New Patient from the fly-out menu.

steps.title: Enter Personal Information
steps.description: Step 1 — Demographics · Personal Information: pick Title, enter First Name (required), Middle Name, Last Name (required), Gender (required), Date Of Birth (required) and SSN (000-00-0000, required), then Home Phone, Cell Phone and Fax.

steps.title: Enter Account Credentials
steps.description: Step 1 — Demographics · Account Credentials: enter the patient’s Username, Email and initial password fields (scroll below Personal Information).

steps.title: Enter Address & Time Zone
steps.description: Step 1 — Demographics · Address: enter the street, city, state, Zip Code (required) and Time Zone (required, defaults to UTC-4 with DST (BR)).

steps.title: Set Care Team & Access
steps.description: Step 1 — Demographics · Care Team & Settings: set Status (Active / Inactive, required), Two Way Authentication (Enabled / Disabled, required), Mobile App Access (Off / On), pick a Provider (required), optionally a System Caregiver, pick at least one Practice Caregiver (required — the form blocks Next with “Select at least one practice caregiver” until this is filled) and optionally Upload Picture (max 1 MB).

steps.title: Advance to Programs
steps.description: Click Next to advance to Programs.

steps.title: Select Care Programs
steps.description: Step 2 — Programs: tick Chronic care management, Remote patient monitoring, or both (at least one is required). The wizard adds a matching RPM / CCM step at the top for each selected program.

steps.title: Advance to Next Step
steps.description: Click Next.

steps.title: Set RPM Start & Monitoring
steps.description: Step 3 — RPM (only if RPM was ticked): set RPM Start Date (required), tick Type Of Monitoring (BP, Glucose, Weight — at least one required).

steps.title: Map RPM Meters
steps.description: Step 3 — RPM · Meter Mapping: for each device, pick Model Number, Extension, enter the 16-character Serial Number and (optional) Gateway Serial Number. Click the + icon to add another meter row.

steps.title: Enter Insurance Details
steps.description: Step 3 — RPM · Insurance: fill in Primary insurance (Insurance Name, Subscriber Id, Insured's Name, Group No.) and, if applicable, Secondary insurance in the row below.

steps.title: Complete CCM Details
steps.description: Click Next. If both programs were ticked, complete the CCM step (Start Date, chronic conditions, care-plan notes) the same way.

steps.title: Save the Patient
steps.description: Click Save Patient (bottom-right) to create the record. Use Previous / Cancel to move back or discard. Notes The stepper across the top (Demographics · Programs · RPM · CCM) shows filled steps as blue check marks and the current step as a highlighted ring; the CCM step only appears when CCM is ticked on step 2. Practice Caregiver is a hard requirement even for RPM-only enrolments — this is the caregiver responsible for reviewing uploads. Meter Serial Number must be exactly 16 characters; the form disables Save Patient until the length matches. RPM Start Date drives the eligibility clock for CPT codes 99453 / 99454 / 99457 / 99458. Two Way Authentication and Mobile App Access can be edited later from the patient profile.

subtasks.title: Lookup Patient (general)
subtasks.purpose: Find a patient across the practice by demographics, provider, caregiver or status.

steps.title: Open Lookup Patient
steps.description: Click Patient Mgmt → Lookup Patient.

steps.title: Enter Patient Name
steps.description: Enter any combination of Last Name, First Name.

steps.title: Pick Practice & Filters
steps.description: Pick a Practice (defaults to the current practice for a Practice Admin), Provider, Caregiver and Status filter.

steps.title: Run or Reset Query
steps.description: Click Query to run the search; use Reset to clear all filters.

steps.title: Narrow Results Further
steps.description: Use the top-right Search box to narrow the returned rows further.

steps.title: Sort by Name
steps.description: Click the Name column arrow to sort A→Z or Z→A.

steps.title: Open Patient Dashboard
steps.description: Click a patient name to open the patient dashboard. Notes Query is the only trigger — changing filters alone will not reload the grid. Practice Admins can only search within their own practice; the Practice dropdown is scoped accordingly.

subtasks.title: Lookup Patient (by RPM date)
subtasks.purpose: Pull the RPM patient population that has activity within a given service date range, along with CPT-eligibility hints.

steps.title: Open RPM Lookup
steps.description: Click Patient Mgmt → Lookup Patient (by RPM date).

steps.title: Enter RPM Date Range
steps.description: Enter the RPM Service Date Range (Start ~ End) using the mm/dd/yyyy pickers.

steps.title: Run the Query
steps.description: Click Query.

steps.title: Sort RPM Results
steps.description: Sort by RPM Start Date (default), Patient Name or DOB using the header arrows.

steps.title: Narrow Results Further
steps.description: Use the top-right Search box to narrow the returned rows.

steps.title: Print, Export, or Email
steps.description: Click Print to open a printable report, Export to download CSV / Excel or Email to send the report to a mailing list.

steps.title: Reset Date Range
steps.description: Click Reset to clear the date range and start over. Notes Measurement Days is the count of unique days the patient uploaded a reading in the selected window — the driver for CPT 99454. Service Time is the accumulated caregiver-review time in the window — the driver for CPT 99457 / 99458. The Eligible CPT Codes column shows which codes will bill for the selected window; rows displaying “–” are not yet eligible.

subtasks.title: Lookup Patient (by CCM date)
subtasks.purpose: Pull the CCM patient population within a service date range along with chronic conditions and billing status.

steps.title: Open CCM Lookup
steps.description: Click Patient Mgmt → Lookup Patient (by CCM date).

steps.title: Enter CCM Date Range
steps.description: Enter the CCM Service Date Range (Start ~ End).

steps.title: Run the Query
steps.description: Click Query.

steps.title: Sort CCM Results
steps.description: Sort by Enrollment Date (default), Patient Name or Last Activity.

steps.title: Distribute the Report
steps.description: Use Print / Export / Email to distribute the report.

steps.title: Reset Date Range
steps.description: Click Reset to clear the range. Notes Chronic Conditions lists every condition captured on the CCM enrolment step — at least two are required for CCM billing. Billing = Pending means the current cycle has not yet been submitted; Billed indicates the claim has been filed for the window. Task 7.12 — Care Management
